arguments.task_description: Implement the Taskboard FastAPI API core: SQLAlchemy 2 models and Alembic migrations for users, sessions, password reset tokens, outbox, teams, team members, projects, tasks, comments, attachments and activity events; repositories; services for auth (register, login, logout, change password, forgot/reset password with emails written to the log and an outbox table), admin user management, teams and members, projects, tasks, comments, search with client-supplied sort field/direction and filters, CSV export, activity feeds; FastAPI routers under /api/v1 with typed error mapping, structured JSON logging with request ids, and a create-admin management command.
arguments.technologies: Python 3.13, FastAPI, Pydantic v2, SQLAlchemy 2, Alembic, PostgreSQL 16, argon2-cffi
